Track 2: Core Concepts

UAE VAT & Tax Logic

UAE e-invoices must compute VAT according to strict FTA rules, including specific category codes, exchange rate conversions, and rounding boundaries.

VAT Categories

Standard RatedCategory S (5%)

Enforced on most goods and services in the UAE, including local retail, consulting, electronics, and standard trade.

Example: A developer consulting service invoiced to a client based in Dubai Mainland.

Zero-RatedCategory Z (0%)

Supplies subject to 0% VAT, allowing suppliers to recover input tax. Applicable to exports, healthcare, and education.

Example: Software licenses exported to a buyer located outside the GCC region.

ExemptCategory E (0%)

Supplies exempt from VAT. Input tax recovery is not allowed. Includes certain financial services and local residential building leases.

Example: Leasing of residential housing units or standard life insurance policies.

Out of ScopeCategory O (0%)

Supplies outside the scope of UAE VAT. Includes supplies made by non-taxable entities, or transactions outside UAE borders (like freezone-to-freezone transit).

Example: Trading of cargo stored in a free trade zone going directly to Europe without entering the mainland.
